data.name: Bahijah
data.long_meaning: Bahijah is an Arabic female name which means 'joyful' or 'happy'. It is derived from the word 'bahja', which signifies happiness and delight. This name is mentioned in the Quran and is popular among Muslims worldwide.

in_arabic.name: باهجة
in_arabic.long_meaning: البهجة هي صفة تعريفية تعبر عن حالة من السعادة والسرور والرضا التي ترتقي إلى مرتبة العفة والشرف، وترتبط ارتباطًا وثيقًا بالتوحيد والتعبد، وتشمل أيضًا الحلم والأمل والجود والتفاؤل، وتعتبر مصدرًا للشغل والشغل والاستمتاع، وتكون مصدرًا للنعم والبركات في الحياة الدنيا والآخرة، وتعتبر أيضًا مصدرًا للشرف والكرم والجود والتفاؤل في المجتمع الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: بہجہ
in_urdu.meaning: بہجہ کا مطلب ہے سکون اور سہولت
in_urdu.long_meaning: بہجہ ہے ایک عربی لفظ جو سکون اور سہولت کا اشارہ کرتا ہے، اس کے معنی ہیں سکون کا ماحول، سہولت کا احساس، خوشی کی حالت، اور سکون کی کیفیت۔ یہ لفظ اسلام میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے اور اس کے معنی خوشی، سکون، سہولت، اور خوشی کی حالت کے ہوتے ہیں۔

data.cultural_impact: The name Bahijah is deeply rooted in the Islamic tradition and culture. In Arabic society, giving a child a meaningful and beautiful name is considered an important aspect of their identity. The name Bahijah reflects the cultural values of joy, happiness, and positivity. It is also associated with the concept of Ihsan (perfection) in Islam, as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said "Allah is beautiful and loves beauty." Thus, the name Bahijah can be considered a beautiful reminder of this divine trait.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bahijah holds a spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition. It reflects the joy and happiness that comes from having faith in God and following His commandments. It is also a reminder of the joy and happiness that awaits the believers in Paradise, as mentioned in the Quran, "For them will be gardens [in Paradise], in them recline [forever]; wearing of fine silk and [couches spread] with brocaded spreads; and [on their heads are] braces adorned with pearls and [terephthal] stones of silver." (Quran 44:55) The spiritual significance of the name Bahijah is also reflected in the hadith of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), "There is no believer in Allah and His Messenger (peace be upon him) who is not given joy in his heart every time he remembers Allah and rejoices in the remembrance of Allah. Allah says, 'I am with My servant.' " (Muslim) Thus, the name Bahijah serves as a daily reminder of the joy and happiness that comes from a strong connection with Allah.
